title: Input Matters: Evaluating Input Structure’s Impact on LLM Summaries of Sports Play-by-Play

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative observation during manual error annotation of generated NBA play-by-play summaries, specifically tracking "Name errors" where models incorrectly hallucinate and substitute well-known "star" players (e.g., LeBron James) in place of the actual, lesser-known players who made the plays.
